india_trends.title: Sebi warns investors against WhatsApp stock tips. Here's how you can avoid such traps
india_trends.summary: SEBI has cautioned investors against exclusive WhatsApp groups spreading unauthorised stock tips and fake profit claims. The regulator flagged astroturfing, overseas numbers, replacement groups and suspicious trading apps, urging investors to verify credentials and use registered intermediaries.
